text:
Maria: Quick idea — add a compact 'cost-id' header at ingress to give a stable token for billing flows.
Josh: what fields are you thinking? we already have lots of ad-hoc span keys.
Maria: keep it tiny: cid (opaque), tenant (if known), route, sample-bit. everything else can be resolved async by enrichment.
Priya: sounds like prefix-level attribution. benefit: billing won't depend on late-enrich success.
Kevin: downside: pushes cardinality to edge logs. we need strict bounds or metrics explode.
Maria: agreed. design: opaque cid + tiny enum tags for cohort/source. enforce ttl on cid and small tag vocab.
Elaine: synchronous tenant lookups at the gateway might be costly for cold clients.
Maria: fallback: stamp partial context (tenant when cached) + opaque cid. downstream async enrichment fills details; billing uses cid as primary key.
Josh: if billing uses cid we need a deterministic mapping and an owner for that mapping service.
Priya: obs-core owns mapping. include a version bit in cid (v1/v2) so we can migrate mappings.
Kevin: keep header short (<64 bytes). example: `X-RW-COSTID: v1:akT3;T=acme;R=gen;S=1`
Elaine: invoices need accuracy. can we tolerate stale mapping? minutes? hours?
Maria: two paths: realtime dashboards use cid counts with reconciliation alerts; invoicing runs off a reconciled daily rollup joined to authoritative metadata.
Josh: sampling needs propagation. if we sample at ingress add sampling bits so aggregators can scale estimates.
Priya: add `S=` flag and `origin=` (hosted/dedicated/private). low-cardinality only.
Kevin: failure modes? if header missing how to handle legacy callers?
Maria: fallback ordering: 1) if tenant in request, derive deterministic cid using tenant+route+timewindow, 2) if none, assign anon cid and cheap bucket. sticky per-session.
Elaine: propose an experiment: enable in one edge region + inference gateway for 2 weeks. measure metric cardinality, sampling fidelity, and reconciliation delta.
Josh: +1. also add an e2e test simulating enrichment outage to ensure billing still emits counts.
Priya: implementation checklist: header spec, obs-core cid mapping API, gateway stamping + tests, aggregator changes to accept cid as primary key.
Maria: I'll draft RFC with header proto and flow diagrams. ping @Priya for obs-core schema section. goal: prototype in 3w, canary in 6w.
obs-bot: deployment succeeded: gateway-canary v2 -> us-west-2 :rocket:
Kevin: will run perf with synthetic 10k rps to measure parsing/latency impact.
Elaine: privacy note: cid must never embed PII and must be rotatable per retention policy.
Josh: migration question: queries today rely on tenant attributes in spans/logs. what's plan?
Maria: migration appendix: parallel writes for 30d, nightly backfill for last 90d to seed cid mapping, and failover query path until backfill completes.
Priya: I'll stub obs-core API and add schema shapes in the RFC to help estimates.
Maria: RFC posted (draft): https://redwood.internal/rfcs/compact-costid-ingress
Elaine: thanks all — I'll schedule the perf run after canary and add checklist items to RFC comments.
Josh: no objections from me. :+1:
Maria: dropping prototype PR when ready.
